channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Debate: Is the Iran war legal?
item.description: It’s seven days since America and Israel launched a war against Iran - the Middle East is on fire, the Qataris are warning of a global economic disaster and Donald Trump’s White House is pumping out propaganda clips of their airstrikes spliced with Hollywood memes. So what kind of world do we now live in? And what could come next?

item.title: Trump says no Iran deal without unconditional surrender
item.description: There's been intense bombing in both the Iranian and Lebanese capitals and promises from the government here in Israel and Washington that even more devastating firepower is on the way.

item.title: Iran strikes Kurdish opposition targets in Iraq
item.description: Airstrikes are intensifying along the Iran-Iraq border as it rapidly becomes a new frontline in the war.

item.title: Iranian people united in face of ‘foreign aggression’ – Iranian analyst in Tehran
item.description: We spoke to Iranian analyst Abas Aslani from Tehran, Krishnan Guru-Murthy asked him about the situation there.

item.title: Sri Lanka evacuates crew of second Iranian vessel day after US sub attack
item.description: Sri Lanka has found itself caught in the middle of the conflict, hoping its decision to let an Iranian navy ship dock in one of its ports won't anger the US and Israel.

item.title: David Lammy: ‘We want the Iranian people to determine their future’
item.description: Senior political correspondent Paul McNamara spoke to the deputy Prime Minister David Lammy and began by asking him about the use of UK bases.

item.title: 7 days of war: Heavy US and Israeli bombing in Iran
item.description: In the last hour, Iranian media is reporting that Iran's Assembly of Experts will meet tomorrow to choose their new supreme leader.

item.title: Israel bombs Lebanon’s capital
item.description: Israel has bombed areas in southern Beirut, as well as conducting a special operation in the Bekaa Valley.

item.title: The conflict is spreading ‘quickly and dangerously’ – Middle East security expert
item.description: We spoke to Emile Hokayem, the Director of Regional Security at the International Institute for Strategic Studies.

item.title: Do Brits fear being dragged into an illegal war?
item.description: The extent of the UK's involvement in this war has significantly changed in the week since Israel and the US first began to strike Iran. What do people think?
